subject: Request for post‑report coverage / bridge letter — SOC 2 Type II
messages:
From: Tina Morales <tina.morales@petrichortx.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: audit@petrichortx.com
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Coverage request — SOC 2 Type II (report ended 2023-12-31)

Hi Soojin,

We are in the final stages of our vendor security review for a major contract and need a short bridge/coverage letter from Redwood that addresses the period since your last SOC 2 Type II report (reporting period ended 2023-12-31). Our procurement team wants explicit language that there have been no material control changes or known exceptions between 2024-01-01 and today (we're aiming to close this week).

Specific asks from procurement:
- A dated bridge letter referencing the 2023-12-31 SOC 2 Type II report.
- Confirmation of any material control changes (if none, state none).
- Short list of evidence items available on request (e.g., change logs, incident logs, KMS attestations).
- A contact for follow-up and an approximate turnaround (we need the letter by 2026-11-29).

I attached our vendor checklist extract for context. Happy to hop on a 20m call if easier.

Thanks,
Tina Morales
Head of Vendor Risk — Petrichor Therapeutics

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Tina Morales <tina.morales@petrichortx.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Coverage request — SOC 2 Type II (report ended 2023-12-31)

Hi Tina — thanks for the clear note and checklist. I’m the security/compliance lead supporting this request. 

We can provide a short bridge letter that references our SOC 2 Type II report ending 2023-12-31 and addresses the post‑report period through the bridge letter date. To help us scope it correctly, two quick clarifying questions:
1) Do you need the letter to explicitly name the Trust Services Criteria included in the SOC 2 (security/confidentiality availability)?
2) Are you expecting a signed PDF from our legal/compliance team, or is a compliance-signed PDF sufficient?

Karthik (cc) will pull the relevant evidence pointers. Marissa (cc) is our legal point for signature and DPA/redline questions. We should be able to share a draft by 2026-11-24 and final by 2026-11-29 if that timeline works.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, Tina Morales <tina.morales@petrichortx.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 11:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Coverage request — SOC 2 Type II (report ended 2023-12-31)

Hi Tina / Soojin — quick note on the evidence side so we can prepackage what you might ask for:
- We can confirm no material changes to our control environment that would materially impact the covered criteria since 2024-01-01.
- Evidence we can make available (redacted where needed): change management runbook and recent change logs (last 18 months), incident response summaries for any P1/P2 (with redactions), KMS key rotation summary and HSM/KMS provider attestation, and our last internal penetration test summary.
- For procurement teams that require artifacts, we typically surface: redacted SOC PDF (we've attached a redacted copy), a short cover letter (draft), and a curated evidence list with pointers to secure SharePoint links.

If you can confirm the exact wording your procurement needs (we often see two patterns: 1) affirmation of 'no material changes/exceptions' or 2) a list of enumerated updates and mitigations), we'll align the draft to that template.

Karthik Iyer
Head of Applied Security — Redwood Inference

From: Tina Morales <tina.morales@petrichortx.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Cc: audit@petrichortx.com
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 08:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Coverage request — SOC 2 Type II (report ended 2023-12-31)

Thanks Soojin / Karthik — procurement requires the shorter affirmation template: a dated statement referencing the SOC 2 report (report date and auditor name optional), explicit confirmation that there are no material control changes or unremediated exceptions since 2024-01-01, and a line that lists evidence types available on request. A signed compliance-signed PDF is acceptable.

If you can get a draft to me by 2026-11-24 that we can review with procurement and legal it would be ideal — failing that, 2026-11-29 is their absolute latest. We attached a small mapping doc (Petrichor_SSO_Inventory_2026-11-10.csv) to show which systems they want covered.

Tina

From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>

Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Coverage request — SOC 2 Type II (report ended 2023-12-31)

Hi Tina — attached is a draft bridge letter and our redacted SOC 2 Type II PDF for your procurement/legal review. Key points in the draft:
- Anchor to SOC 2 Type II report for period ending 2023-12-31 (auditor: Brightline LLP).
- Affirmation: no material changes to controls affecting the security and confidentiality criteria and no unremediated exceptions identified since 2024-01-01 through 2026-11-29.
- Evidence note: we list change logs, incident response summaries (redacted), KMS rotation summary, and access review records as items available on request.

Attachments included: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2023-12-31_redacted.pdf, post-audit-bridge-draft-petrichor.docx.

Next steps: please review the draft and indicate any procurement-specific phrasing changes. Once you confirm, Marissa will sign the final PDF and we will provide secure links to the evidence bundle. If procurement needs anything more than the listed evidence types we can discuss time to produce.

Best regards,
Soojin Lee
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
